name: rippl-studio
description: RIPPL Studio: an interactive fluid simulation for Android and the web.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && node node_modules/@capacitor/cli/bin/capacitor sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
